title: The cloud review boot still runs the omp CLI harness, against A1's letter
body:
A1 says every worker (implement and role jobs), local and cloud, runs on pi-durable. Every per-tick worker dispatch through the sandbox door IS a hosted WorkerAgent on pi-durable (sandbox-executor.ts, 'Every worker is a WorkerAgent', ticks xd3/hxd) — but the review job deliberately runs a CLI harness in its container: run-workflow.ts calls reviewHarness(), whose floor drops both pi-durable and the deleted 'pi' and falls back to omp on GLM ('the review is the one cloud boot that still runs a CLI harness in its container', tick jhp), whatever the overlay's review cell names. The operator's recorded exceptions in the epic notes cover only the LOCAL claude frontier rung; this cloud-side review exception lives only in code comments. Either the close-out scores A1 with this exception recorded in the epic record, or hosting the review on pi-durable is work worth a tick of its own — as it stands A1's letter and the shipped behavior disagree, and a reviewer scoring A1 from the text alone would call it met when the review dispatch's own attempt record says omp.
evidence: cloudflare/src/run-workflow.ts:2530-2532 (superviseReview: review routed through reviewHarness, 'the one cloud boot that still runs a CLI harness'); cloudflare/src/worker-boot.ts NOT_A_REVIEW_HARNESS = {pi-durable, pi} and REVIEW_DEFAULT_HARNESS = omp
